en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of an ornate, historic hotel named 'Hotel Terminus' with a sign that reads 'GRAND HOTEL TERMINUS' on the roof. The building is multi-storied with elaborate architectural details and is surrounded by other similar buildings and tree-lined streets. In the background, forested hills are visible, suggesting a scenic, possibly spa-town location. The bottom of the postcard has printed text.
